Method of Attack: Encrypts files on the computer appending .crypted extension
Terminates processes associated with security software, email servers, database servers, backup software, and accounting software using taskkill.exe
Shuts down related Windows services using net stop command
Uses Windows Restart Manager API to terminate processes or services locking files
Deploys customized ransom notes per victim including stolen data details and Tor dark web URL for negotiation
Impacted Systems: Processes and services including QuickBooks, MSSQLServerADHelper100, postg* processes
Indicators of Compromise: Tor dark web URL for ransom negotiation
